initialHotspotProfile.method: V8 sampled self time in an initial CPU-only common-English profile; includes five cold and five warm-index measured searches plus priming, warmup, fixture generation and outside-measurement GC

implementation: Bounded preview code-point slicing without surrogate-pair arrays; no new cache or deferred getter

baseline.fixture: 600 six-second cues per document, 60-minute authored transcripts; alternating English and Chinese; no saved quotations or translations
baseline.summary: Each summary field is the median of five runs by default; slice percentiles are computed within each run, then summarized. Raw per-run observations are retained.
baseline.kind: CPU-only synchronous scheduler drain; no browser, rendering, I/O, native or actual timer latency claims
